messages:
zoe-product: We rolled out experiment `promo-plan-v2` at 08:00 UTC and started routing new signups to plan alias pro_v2_exp in Stripe. Hearing from support that several customers were charged the wrong rate (higher). Can someone check the NS mapping?

rafa-eng: digging in. The connector uses a plan_id->ns_item_map table. I see entries for pro_v1 and pro_v2 but not for pro_v2_exp. When the connector doesn't find a mapping it falls back to default_item_id which is the legacy pro_v1 price (higher). That would explain the overcharge.

mia-finops: how many customers affected and magnitude? Support ticket queue shows ~7 customers flagged so far.

levi-billing: quick query: stripe subscription events where plan_id ~ 'pro_v2_exp' in the last 6h -> 24 results, 18 of those billed in today's invoice run. Using the default_item_id produced invoice lines at $299 instead of expected $199. Rough estimated impact ~ $3600.

ana-acct: we need to treat this as a pricing misconfiguration. Accounting wants reversals for customer-facing charges and corrected invoices. For small amounts we can credit and rebill; for larger accounts we'll coordinate credit + invoice adjustment. Please provide list and amounts.

pricing-experiments-bot: Experiment rollout note: promo-plan-v2 toggled ON by zoe-product at 2026-03-20T08:00:00Z. Variant: pro_v2_exp assigned to new signups.

rafa-eng: root cause: our mapping code expects exact match on plan.id. Experiment added a new alias without updating ns mapping. Code snippet: 
```
ns_item = plan_to_ns_map[plan.id]
if (!ns_item) {
  ns_item = default_item_id // legacy fallback
}
```
We should fail hard on unknown plan ids and alert product to update mapping before experiment rollouts.

mia-finops: for mitigation: 1) patch connector to return error for unmapped plan ids (feature flag gated), 2) update plan_to_ns_map with pro_v2_exp -> NS-ITEM-2009, 3) run backfill to correct today's invoices.

levi-billing: I'll prepare a backfill job: identify invoices created today with external_id pattern invoice_batch_20260320 and lines with external_item = default_item_id and link back to stripe subscription -> replace line with NS-ITEM-2009 and post credit memo + corrected invoice. We'll also tag each correction with 'auto-correct from experiment pro_v2_exp'.

ana-acct: accounting sign-off: approve creating credit memos and corrected invoices for impacted customers. Please include audit memo: 'Experiment rollout mis-mapped plan id pro_v2_exp; auto-corrected'. For any revenue recognition impact > $500, route to finance lead for manual review.

zoe-product: thanks. I missed adding the mapping to the experiment checklist. We'll update the rollout docs and add a preflight that asserts mapping entries exist.

rafa-eng: opened PR to 1) treat unknown plan ids as processing errors (feature flag: strict_plan_mapping), 2) add logging/alert when plan_to_ns_map lookup fails, 3) add backfill utility. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/892 (draft).

pricing-experiments-bot: Action created: BILL-1420 - backfill corrections for pro_v2_exp mis-mapped invoices; assign to levi-billing.

levi-billing: I'll run the identification query and post a CSV with columns: stripe_subscription_id, stripe_customer_id, invoice_id_ns, original_item, expected_item, amount_diff, remedy (credit+reissue). Will start with highest amounts first.

mia-finops: please include communication templates for customer emails. We'll offer apology, corrected invoice, and note that their card will be refunded for the difference when payment already processed.

rafa-eng: timeline: can merge mapping update + strict flag today. Backfill will run after accounting sign-off; aim to finish corrections within 6-8 hours. Also adding an integration test that runs a sample Stripe subscription with unknown plan and asserts connector fails with clear error.

zoe-product: I'll pause the experiment rollout until mappings are confirmed. Too many customer-facing side effects.

levi-billing: executing initial scan now. Posting CSV link when ready.

ana-acct: one more control: please ensure corrected invoices include original invoice reference in a custom field so auditors can trace the adjustment.

mia-finops: thanks team. prioritize customers with chargebacks/tickets first. Keep this thread updated with final list and net impact.

rafa-eng: merged small mapping update to staging and enabled strict flag behind feature flag. Deploy to staging for verification.

pricing-experiments-bot: Update: BILL-1420 assigned to levi-billing; high priority.

levi-billing: scan results uploaded: https://internal-files/redwood/billing/pro_v2_exp_scan_20260320.csv (contains 24 rows, 18 billed, 6 trial signups). Starting remediation queue.

zoe-product: apologizing to customers now and pausing rollout. We'll add the checklist item and a guarded toggle for future experiments.

mia-finops: please post remediation completion summary in this thread once done. Also include GL impact and any manual adjustments flagged for month-end.

levi-billing: will do. starting corrections now.
